faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything about ordering, paying, delivery and returns — in one place.

items.a: Yes. Every product at Verella is 100% original, sourced from the brands themselves or from their authorised distributors. We never sell testers, copies or "inspired by" versions.

items.q: How do I choose a size?
items.a: Many fragrances come in more than one size. Pick the size on the product page — the price, availability and code for that exact size update as you choose.

items.q: A product is sold out. Will it come back?
items.a: Most of our range is restocked regularly. Message us on WhatsApp with the product name and we'll let you know when it's back.

items.q: Do I need an account to order?
items.a: No. You can check out as a guest with your name, phone number and address. An account just saves your addresses and keeps your order history in one place.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash on delivery, InstaPay and Vodafone Cash. For InstaPay and Vodafone Cash, transfer the order total to the number shown at checkout and upload a screenshot of the transfer; we confirm your order as soon as the payment is verified.

items.q: How do I know my order went through?
items.a: You'll see a confirmation page with your order number (it starts with VR-) straight after checkout. Keep that number — it's how we find your order quickly.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, as long as it hasn't been shipped yet. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number as soon as possible.

Orders are usually delivered within 2–5 business days, depending on your governorate. Orders confirmed on a Friday or public holiday are processed on the next business day.

items.q: How can I follow my order?
items.a: If you have an account, your orders and their status are under My Account. Guests can message us on WhatsApp with their order number at any time.

Unopened items in their original sealed packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery. For hygiene reasons, fragrances and personal care products that have been opened or used can't be returned. See Shipping & Returns for the full policy.

items.q: My order arrived damaged or wrong — what now?
items.a: We're sorry! Send us your order number and photos on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery and we'll replace it or refund you at no extra cost.

sections.title: Delivery areas & fees
body: We deliver to all 27 governorates in Egypt. The delivery fee depends on the governorate you're shipping to, and you'll always see it at checkout before placing your order — there are no hidden charges at the door.

sections.title: Processing & delivery times
body: Cash-on-delivery orders are prepared right away. InstaPay and Vodafone Cash orders are prepared once your transfer has been verified.
Most orders arrive within 2–5 business days of confirmation, depending on the governorate. During sales and holiday seasons delivery can take a little longer — we'll contact you if there's any delay.

sections.title: Receiving your order
body: Our courier will call the phone number on your order before delivery, so please keep it reachable. For cash-on-delivery orders, have the order total ready.
Please check your parcel when it arrives. If the outer packaging is visibly damaged, you can refuse it and contact us.

sections.title: Returns
body: You can return items within 14 days of delivery as long as they are unopened, unused and in their original packaging with any seals and cellophane intact. Fashion items must be unworn with their tags attached.
For hygiene reasons, fragrances, musk, oud and personal care products that have been opened, unsealed or used cannot be returned or exchanged.
To start a return, message us on WhatsApp or through the contact page with your order number and the items you'd like to return. We'll arrange collection or tell you where to send them.

sections.title: Damaged, faulty or incorrect items
body: If something arrives damaged, faulty or isn't what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and photos. We'll replace it or refund you in full, including any delivery costs.

sections.title: Refunds
body: Once we receive and inspect a returned item, we'll refund the item price within 7 business days via InstaPay or Vodafone Cash. The original delivery fee isn't refundable, and return delivery is paid by the customer unless the item was damaged, faulty or incorrect.

sections.title: Exchanges
body: Want a different size or product instead? Returns that meet the conditions above can be exchanged for another item of equal or higher value — just tell us when you start your return.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: What we collect, why, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Who we are
body: This policy explains how Verella ("we", "us") handles personal information when you visit our website, create an account or place an order. We process personal data in line with applicable Egyptian law, including the Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: Information you give us: your name, phone number, email address, delivery addresses, the details of your orders, messages you send through our contact form, and — if you pay by InstaPay or Vodafone Cash — the transfer screenshot you upload.
Account information: if you create an account, your email address and a securely hashed password. We never store your password in readable form.

Information collected automatically: essential cookies that keep you signed in, remember your bag and your language, and — only if you accept analytics cookies — anonymous usage data such as the pages you visit and the device you use.

sections.title: How we use it
body: To process, deliver and support your orders; to verify wallet payments; to reply to your messages; to keep your account secure; to prevent fraud and spam; and, with your consent, to understand how the site is used so we can improve it.
We don't sell your personal information, and we don't send marketing messages unless you've asked us to.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: Only with the service providers we need to run the store: the courier that delivers your order (name, phone and address), our hosting and image-storage providers, our email provider, and — if you accept analytics cookies — Google Analytics. Each of them may use your data only to provide their service to us.
We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our customers and business from fraud.

sections.title: Cookies
body: Essential cookies are required for the site to work (sign-in, bag, language) and can't be switched off. Analytics cookies are optional and are only set if you choose "Accept" in the cookie banner. You can change your choice at any time from the "Cookie settings" link in the footer.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep order records for as long as needed for accounting, tax and warranty purposes. Account details are kept until you ask us to delete your account. Payment screenshots are kept only as long as needed to verify and reconcile the payment.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal information, or withdraw a consent you've given. You can update most account details yourself from My Account; for anything else, contact us and we'll respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: Security
body: The site is served over an encrypted connection, passwords are hashed, and access to customer data in our dashboard is limited to staff who need it. No online service is perfectly secure, so please keep your password private.

sections.title: Changes & contact
body: We may update this policy from time to time; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions about your data? Email us at verellabrands@gmail.com or use our contact page.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.subtitle: The terms that apply when you shop at Verella.

sections.title: About these terms
body: These terms apply to your use of the Verella website and to every order placed through it. By placing an order you confirm that you have read and accept them, along with our Privacy Policy and Shipping & Returns policy.

sections.title: Products
body: All products sold by Verella are original and sourced from the brands or their authorised distributors. We do our best to show products accurately, but colours and packaging may differ slightly from the photos, and brands sometimes update their packaging.

sections.title: Prices
body: Prices are shown in Egyptian pounds (EGP). The delivery fee for your governorate is added at checkout and shown before you confirm. If a product is listed at an obviously incorrect price because of an error, we'll contact you before processing the order and you can cancel it at no cost.

sections.title: Orders
body: Your order is an offer to buy. It is accepted when we confirm it — for InstaPay and Vodafone Cash, once your payment has been verified. We may decline or cancel an order, for example if a product is out of stock, the payment can't be verified or we suspect fraud; if you've already paid, you'll receive a full refund.

sections.title: Payment
body: We accept cash on delivery, InstaPay and Vodafone Cash. For wallet payments, transfer the exact order total to the number shown at checkout and upload proof of the transfer. Orders with a transfer that can't be verified within 48 hours may be cancelled.

sections.title: Delivery, returns and refunds
body: Delivery, returns, exchanges and refunds are handled as described in our Shipping & Returns policy, which forms part of these terms. Nothing in these terms affects your rights under the Egyptian Consumer Protection Law No. 181 of 2018.

sections.title: Your account
body: If you create an account, keep your password confidential and let us know straight away if you think someone else has used it. You're responsible for the accuracy of the details you give us, including your delivery address and phone number.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The Verella name, logo, V mark and the site's design and content belong to Verella. Brand names and trademarks of the products we sell belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: Liability
body: We're responsible for delivering the products you order as described. We aren't liable for losses that weren't foreseeable, or for delays caused by events outside our reasonable control. Always follow the brand's instructions for using fragrance and personal care products, and do a patch test if you have sensitive skin.

sections.title: Governing law & contact
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. We may update them from time to time; the version in force when you place an order applies to that order. Questions? Email verellabrands@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp.
